one_line: A master silk artisan of ancient Kamarupa, weaving prized muga and pat textiles along the early trade routes of Assam.

appearance.age_look: mid-20s, lean but sturdy build from manual loom work
appearance.face: oval face with warm medium-brown complexion, soft yet focused eyes with slightly upturned outer corners, straight nose, gently arched brows, a few faint loom-callus marks on fingers, default expression calm and intent as if listening to the rhythm of the loom
appearance.hair: long straight black hair oiled smooth, parted slightly off-center and gathered into a low knot at the nape wrapped with a narrow off-white cloth band; a thin plait falls from the knot over the right shoulder
appearance.costume: ankle-length handwoven wrap lower garment (like an early mekhela) in undyed muga-silk gold with a subtle narrow maroon border, paired with a long-sleeved, hip-length pat-silk tunic in soft ivory-white with a simple round neck and side slits for movement; over this, a light rectangular shawl of pale cream silk with fine red and green geometric motifs, draped from left shoulder across the chest and around the waist; feet in simple brown leather sandals; minimal jewellery: a slim copper bangle on each wrist and small round brass ear-studs, all textiles showing slight irregularities of handloom weave.
appearance.signature: a wooden backstrap loom beam and shuttle: the character carries a polished dark-brown wooden loom beam resting on one shoulder, and holds a slim, pale wooden shuttle threaded with golden muga silk, a few loose strands trailing visibly

ref_desc: A lean mid-20s Kamarupa silk weaver with an oval medium-brown face, long black hair in a low-knotted banded style with a side plait, wearing a golden muga wrap skirt, ivory pat-silk tunic, cream patterned shawl, copper bangles, and carrying a dark wooden loom beam and pale shuttle with golden silk.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of a Kamarupa silk weaver: a lean mid-20s artisan with an oval medium-brown face, calm focused eyes, and long straight black hair oiled smooth, parted slightly off-center, gathered into a low knot at the nape wrapped with a narrow off-white cloth band, plus a thin plait falling over the right shoulder. Dress them in an ankle-length handwoven wrap lower garment in undyed golden muga silk with a narrow maroon border, a long-sleeved hip-length pat-silk tunic in soft ivory-white with a simple round neck and side slits, and a light rectangular shawl of pale cream silk decorated with fine red and green geometric patterns, draped from left shoulder across the chest and around the waist; add simple brown leather sandals, a slim copper bangle on each wrist, and small round brass ear-studs. Show the texture of handloom silk with slight irregularities. Their signature prop is a polished dark-brown wooden loom beam resting across one shoulder and a slim pale wooden shuttle in one hand threaded with golden muga silk, loose strands trailing; keep the palette to golden muga yellow, ivory white, maroon red, pale green, and dark brown wood, and present front, side, and back views in consistent anime proportions.
